integrity: Self-contained proof and two independently implemented Python 3 standard-library finite verification scripts with output markers; no unperformed external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Full directed strict refinement order and one partition with two unequal blocks only; no claim for equal-sized anchor blocks, multiple block anchors, cover relations, identification among arbitrary structures, or optimality of the four-round bound. Finite checks are corroborative rather than an infinite proof. Specialized earlier priority remains possible.
title: Four-round orbit recovery in asymmetrically marked partition lattices
